$comment: Spec for the luckgage province stamp set. Hand this whole file to the asset generator. Province ids match apps/mobile/src/features/journeys/vietnamMap.ts (34 units in force since 1 July 2025, Resolution 202/2025/QH15).

series.unlockRule: A province stamp unlocks automatically when the user has a started trip (start date <= today) whose destination coordinates fall inside that province, using the same province lookup as the journeys map. No check-in, no extra taps.
series.lockedState: Rendered in code from the same PNG: tinted with the outline colour at 35% opacity (a stamp silhouette). Do not generate separate locked artwork.

output.size: Generate 1024x1024 PNG with a transparent background. Masters are kept untracked in docs/gamification/stamp-masters/; the app ships copies cropped to the stamp edge and resized to 384x512.
deliverables: apps/mobile/src/features/journeys/stamps.ts exporting a manifest: id -> require('../../../assets/stamps/{id}.png') plus nameVi, nameEn, captionVi, captionEn, region, coastal
A row per stamp added to the asset inventory in docs/BRAND_SYSTEM.md

artDirection.basePrompt: Use case: collectible travel stamp for a mobile app. Asset type: single postage-stamp illustration cutout. Primary request: a portrait postage stamp (3:4 ratio) with classic perforated scalloped edges, printed on warm cream paper, centered in a square transparent canvas with generous padding. Inside a thin inner frame sits one simple illustration of the subject below. A small circular luggage-tag hole motif sits in the top-right corner of the stamp as the series mark. Style/medium: premium flat editorial screen-print illustration with subtle paper grain, limited flat colors, strong clean shapes, slightly imperfect hand-drawn geometry, matching the luckgage Luki mascot style. Composition: one hero subject, at most one secondary element, readable at 72px.

palette.rule: Use the paper and ink colors plus at most three other flat colors: the stamp's accent and up to two brand colors.

constraints: no text, letters, numbers, or wordmarks anywhere (the app renders the province name)
no national flags except where the subject itself is a flagpole
no people's faces in detail; figures, if any, are small silhouettes
no photorealism, 3D, gradients, glossy effects, drop shadows outside the stamp, or watermarks
transparent background outside the stamp edge
all 34 stamps must look like one series: same frame, edge, paper, corner mark, and line weight
acceptance: series consistency checked by viewing all 34 in a 6-column grid
accurate architecture/landform silhouettes; review each against a reference photo before shipping

regions.central: Miền Trung và Tây Nguyên / Central Vietnam and Highlands

stamps.subject: Khue Van Cac pavilion at the Temple of Literature: a square two-tier pavilion with circular sun windows on four brick pillars, a few lotus leaves in front
stamps.captionVi: Khuê Văn Các, biểu tượng nghìn năm văn hiến.
stamps.captionEn: Khue Van Cac, symbol of a thousand years of learning.

stamps.subject: Ngo Mon gate of the Hue Imperial City with its five-pavilion roof line, the Perfume River as a calm band below, one conical hat floating on a small boat
stamps.captionVi: Ngọ Môn Đại Nội bên dòng sông Hương.
stamps.captionEn: The Imperial City's Noon Gate by the Perfume River.

stamps.subject: a sea of clouds filling the valley below the O Quy Ho mountain pass, a winding road ribbon on the ridge, sharp peaks rising above the clouds
stamps.captionVi: Biển mây trên đèo Ô Quy Hồ.
stamps.captionEn: A sea of clouds over O Quy Ho pass.

stamps.subject: white ban (Bauhinia) flowers on a branch in the foreground, the Dien Bien Phu Victory Monument on D1 hill as a small silhouette behind, Muong Thanh valley fields
stamps.captionVi: Hoa ban trắng và đồi D1 lịch sử.
stamps.captionEn: White ban blossoms and historic D1 hill.

stamps.subject: the heart-shaped tea hill of Moc Chau plateau with neat tea rows, a white plum blossom branch in one corner
stamps.captionVi: Đồi chè trái tim cao nguyên Mộc Châu.
stamps.captionEn: Moc Chau's heart-shaped tea hill.

stamps.subject: a pink peach blossom branch framing the misty peaks of Mau Son mountain
stamps.captionVi: Hoa đào xứ Lạng và núi Mẫu Sơn.
stamps.captionEn: Peach blossoms and Mau Son mountain.

stamps.subject: the Trong Mai twin rocks (fighting cock islets) rising from calm emerald water in Ha Long Bay, one small junk boat with a brown sail
stamps.captionVi: Hòn Trống Mái giữa vịnh Hạ Long.
stamps.captionEn: The Trong Mai rocks in Ha Long Bay.

stamps.subject: the massive stone south gate of the Ho Dynasty Citadel, three arched openings in large cut stone blocks, grass on top
stamps.captionVi: Thành nhà Hồ, di sản thế giới bằng đá.
stamps.captionEn: The Ho Dynasty Citadel, a stone World Heritage site.

stamps.subject: a simple thatched-roof wooden village house of Lang Sen beside a pond with pink lotus flowers
stamps.captionVi: Mái tranh Làng Sen bên hồ sen hồng.
stamps.captionEn: A thatched house in Lang Sen by a lotus pond.

stamps.subject: the many peaks of Hong Linh mountain above the gentle curve of the La River
stamps.captionVi: Núi Hồng, sông La.
stamps.captionEn: Hong Linh mountain and the La River.

stamps.subject: Ban Gioc waterfall: wide multi-tiered white cascades over green limestone, a small bamboo raft on the turquoise pool
stamps.captionVi: Thác Bản Giốc hùng vĩ.
stamps.captionEn: The mighty Ban Gioc waterfall.

stamps.subject: the Lung Cu flag tower on Dragon Mountain at Vietnam's northern tip, a red flag on top, rocky karst ridges and buckwheat flowers below
stamps.captionVi: Cột cờ Lũng Cú nơi địa đầu Tổ quốc.
stamps.captionEn: Lung Cu flag tower at the country's northern tip.

stamps.subject: golden rice terraces of Mu Cang Chai curving down a slope, the Fansipan summit with its small pyramid marker in the distance
stamps.captionVi: Ruộng bậc thang mùa vàng dưới đỉnh Fansipan.
stamps.captionEn: Golden rice terraces below Fansipan.

stamps.subject: rolling Tan Cuong tea hills in front, the calm blue Ba Be lake with a dugout canoe behind
stamps.captionVi: Chè Tân Cương và hồ Ba Bể.
stamps.captionEn: Tan Cuong tea and Ba Be lake.

stamps.subject: the triple-gate entrance of the Hung Kings Temple on Nghia Linh mountain, stone steps leading up through trees
stamps.captionVi: Đền Hùng, nơi cội nguồn dân tộc.
stamps.captionEn: The Hung Kings Temple, the nation's roots.

stamps.subject: a flat quai thao hat with fringe for quan ho folk singing resting beside a bunch of red Luc Ngan lychees
stamps.captionVi: Nón quai thao quan họ và vải thiều.
stamps.captionEn: A quan ho singer's hat and fresh lychees.

stamps.subject: the three-tier wooden bell tower of Keo Pagoda with curved roof corners, a branch of longan fruit in the foreground
stamps.captionVi: Gác chuông chùa Keo và nhãn lồng.
stamps.captionEn: Keo Pagoda's bell tower and longans.

stamps.subject: a branch of red flamboyant (phuong) flowers over the limestone islands and blue bay of Cat Ba
stamps.captionVi: Thành phố hoa phượng đỏ và đảo Cát Bà.
stamps.captionEn: The city of red flamboyants and Cat Ba island.

stamps.subject: a small rowing boat on a calm river winding between steep karst towers at Trang An, a cave mouth at water level
stamps.captionVi: Thuyền nan giữa núi đá Tràng An.
stamps.captionEn: A rowing boat among Trang An's karst towers.

stamps.subject: the arched cave entrance of Phong Nha with a boat on the river flowing out of it, stalactites at the mouth
stamps.captionVi: Động Phong Nha, vương quốc hang động.
stamps.captionEn: Phong Nha, the kingdom of caves.

stamps.subject: the yellow Dragon Bridge arching over the Han River, with two Hoi An silk lanterns hanging in the foreground
stamps.captionVi: Cầu Rồng sông Hàn và đèn lồng Hội An.
stamps.captionEn: The Dragon Bridge and Hoi An lanterns.

stamps.subject: the To Vo natural stone arch on Ly Son island at sunset over the sea, a tall Kon Tum rong communal house roof as a small silhouette on the far headland
stamps.captionVi: Cổng Tò Vò Lý Sơn và nhà rông Tây Nguyên.
stamps.captionEn: Ly Son's To Vo arch and a highland rong house.

stamps.subject: the Cham Twin Towers (Thap Doi) of red brick in front, the round Bien Ho (T'Nung) lake ringed by pine trees behind
stamps.captionVi: Tháp Đôi Chăm Pa và Biển Hồ Pleiku.
stamps.captionEn: The Cham Twin Towers and Pleiku's Bien Ho lake.

stamps.subject: the Po Nagar Cham tower on its hill above the turquoise Nha Trang bay, a small bunch of Ninh Thuan grapes in the corner
stamps.captionVi: Tháp Bà Ponagar bên vịnh Nha Trang.
stamps.captionEn: Po Nagar tower above Nha Trang bay.

stamps.subject: a misty pine forest of Da Lat with yellow wild sunflowers (da quy) in front, the soft red sand dunes of Mui Ne as a band at the bottom
stamps.captionVi: Rừng thông Đà Lạt và đồi cát Mũi Né.
stamps.captionEn: Da Lat pines and Mui Ne sand dunes.

stamps.subject: a friendly elephant silhouette beside a coffee branch with red cherries, the hexagonal basalt columns of Ganh Da Dia at the bottom edge
stamps.captionVi: Cà phê Buôn Ma Thuột và Gành Đá Đĩa.
stamps.captionEn: Buon Ma Thuot coffee and Ganh Da Dia rocks.

stamps.subject: the clock tower of Ben Thanh Market in front, the Landmark 81 skyscraper silhouette rising behind
stamps.captionVi: Chợ Bến Thành giữa thành phố năng động.
stamps.captionEn: Ben Thanh Market in a lively city.

stamps.subject: dense tropical forest of Cat Tien National Park with a hornbill on a branch, a cluster of cashew fruits in the foreground
stamps.captionVi: Rừng Cát Tiên và hạt điều Bình Phước.
stamps.captionEn: Cat Tien forest and Binh Phuoc cashews.

stamps.subject: the lone Ba Den mountain rising from flat plains, a cable car line climbing toward the summit
stamps.captionVi: Núi Bà Đen, nóc nhà Nam Bộ.
stamps.captionEn: Ba Den mountain, the roof of the south.

stamps.subject: Cai Rang floating market: two wooden boats loaded with fruit, a tall bamboo pole hanging produce to advertise what is sold
stamps.captionVi: Chợ nổi Cái Răng trên sông Hậu.
stamps.captionEn: Cai Rang floating market on the Hau River.

stamps.subject: a row of leaning coconut palms along a canal with a small sampan, ripe tropical fruit on the bank
stamps.captionVi: Kênh rạch rợp dừa miền Tây.
stamps.captionEn: Coconut-lined canals of the Mekong Delta.

stamps.subject: a field of pink lotus flowers of Thap Muoi with one white egret standing among the leaves
stamps.captionVi: Sen hồng Tháp Mười.
stamps.captionEn: Pink lotus fields of Thap Muoi.

stamps.subject: the ship-shaped monument at Ca Mau Cape at the southern tip, mangrove roots in the foreground, a line of white wind turbines on the horizon
stamps.captionVi: Mũi Cà Mau, điểm cực Nam.
stamps.captionEn: Ca Mau Cape, the southernmost point.

stamps.subject: the green Tra Su cajuput forest with a duckweed-covered waterway and a small boat, a tall sugar palm (thot not) tree at the side
stamps.captionVi: Rừng tràm Trà Sư và cây thốt nốt.
stamps.captionEn: Tra Su cajuput forest and sugar palms.
